title: Outlook on the web: conversational email drafting with Copilot (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and Integrated Apps blocking path are supported, and it distinguishes that broad app control from an unconfirmed drafting control. The feature-specific default, licence split and meter remain undocumented in the sources searched. Minor corrections are to cite the separate Mac roadmap entry and remove the licence-check step that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The app-blocking path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Block app.
claims.quote: Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps. ... Select the Available Apps list. ... Select an app from the Available Apps list to open the overview pane. ... Select Block app.

claims.claim: The CoPilot entry's settings apply to both Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat apps.

claims.claim: App blocking applies tenant-wide to all users in Outlook and the Microsoft Copilot application.
